storyTitle: Track Holiday Fund & Bill Reduction Progress
oneSentenceStory: Review current LBG Coin balance progress toward the Holiday Spending Money goal and check payment-linked statement credit options.
customerSituation: Customer visits the mobile rewards overview to check accumulated points and evaluate cash-equivalent statement credit progress.
storyTension: Ensuring earned points translate transparently into predictable bill reductions without distracting gamification.
customerResolution: Clear display of points balance, active goal progress, and direct payment-linked redemption pathways.
primaryOutcome: Check cash-equivalent rewards status and manage payment-linked point allocation.
